Abhimanyu Mishra became the youngest GM in the world of chess when he achieved the title a few years ago at the age of 12 years and 4 months. Since then he has grown from strength to strength and has reached a rating of close to 2650! Now he had a chance to take on Magnus Carlsen in this high voltage encounter at the Total Chess Championship Pilot in Budapest, Hungary. Check out this amazing game along with commentary by IM Sagar Shah.
